description: This file contains utility functions for tensor operations in the PyTorch library, including tensor grouping, reordering, and sparse tensor flattening/unflattening.

methods.name: take_tensors
methods.description: Groups tensors into batches based on size limit and granularity.

methods.name: reorder_tensors_like
methods.description: Reorders a vector of tensors to match the order of another tensor list.

methods.name: get_indices
methods.description: Retrieves the indices tensor from a sparse tensor.

methods.name: get_values
methods.description: Retrieves the values tensor from a sparse tensor.

methods.name: flatten_sparse_tensors
methods.description: Flattens a list of sparse tensors into a pair of dense tensors (indices and values).

methods.name: unflatten_sparse_tensors
methods.description: Reconstructs sparse tensors from flattened indices and values tensors.
